text:
Maria Chen: Heads up — I'm proposing we split SIEM export access into two roles: `triage_view` (short-lived, masked) and `forensics_read` (longer, requires justification + JIT). The current single `siem_read` is too coarse for external partners and SOC contractors.

Aj Patel: agree in principle. how do you envision JIT for forensics_read? ticket + 8h TTL? :thinking_face:

Maria Chen: yeah, ticket + approver from secops, default 8h TTL but extendable with manager approval. we should also enforce KMS unwrap logging and rotate the proxy key weekly.

Devon Ruiz: we need an automated audit record — ideally a signed attestation when keys are unwrapped. security-bot can emit an entry to the audit stream.

security-bot: New policy draft: SIEM_FORensics_Unwrap requires CMK alias/siem-prod-unlock -> log event ID added to audit-stream.

Samir: quick question: current exporter uses a service account with broad iam:Decrypt. Are we going to move to an ephemeral worker that fetches a wrapped token from vault instead?

Maria Chen: yes, move to short-lived tokens. plan: exporter requests wrapped token from vault (audited), vault unwraps via KMS and returns session token to the exporter pod. no long-lived IAM decrypt perms on CI users.

Aj Patel: can you share a config snippet? helpful for infra to review.

Maria Chen: sure — example of the exporter wrapper call:

```
# siem-exporter bootstrap
curl -s -X POST https://vault.company.internal/v1/siem/wrap \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $POD_ID_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"role":"siem-exporter","ttl":"2h"}' \
| jq -r .data.wrapped_key > /tmp/wrapped
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb:///tmp/wrapped --key-id alias/siem-exporter-cmk \
  --output text --query Plaintext | base64 --decode > /tmp/session_token
```

Devon Ruiz: nice. one gotcha: if CMK rotates mid-incident we risk unwrapping failures. Ana, oncall — we had a similar P1 last month that blocked forensic access, right?

Ana (oncall): yup — INC-2025. root cause was an unexpected key rotation during incident hours and no fallback key. caused 25m delay while secops manually granted temporary access.

Samir: can we add a fallback key policy: if primary CMK unwrap fails, attempt key alias/siem-fallback-cmk and emit high-severity alert?

Maria Chen: Exactly. fallback + circuit breaker that notifies PagerDuty and creates a short-lived admin token that requires 2 approvers to use. also add a queueing mode so exporter buffers events locally for up to 1h encrypted-at-rest.

Devon Ruiz: logging expectations: when someone requests forensics_read JIT, we need these audit fields: requester, approver, justification, TTL, CMK_used, unwrap_event_id, ticket_id. Add them to the SIEM export as structured JSON fields.

Aj Patel: do we want to redact PII before export for triage_view? that should be automatic. we currently rely on regexes which are flaky.

Maria Chen: prefer a policy-driven redaction pipeline. triage_view goes through redaction ruleset v1.2; forensics_read bypasses redaction but requires separate retention and access controls.

Samir: operational question: how will RBAC changes roll out? phased? feature flag?

Maria Chen: phase 1 — create roles and map service accounts (no enforcement). phase 2 — enable enforcement for new requests only. phase 3 — cutover and revoke legacy `siem_read`. will communicate in release notes and tag impacted owners.

Devon Ruiz: add a migration script to convert legacy grants -> triage_view or forensics_read based on last use and justification. we should auto-create tickets for owners of grants older than 90 days.

Ana (oncall): also add a fastpath for incident responders: a pre-approved emergency group that can request forensics_read but still requires post-hoc approval within 24h. avoids blocking live IR.

Maria Chen: good call. I'll draft the policy doc and PR. expecting infra + secops + legal signoff.

Aj Patel: one more thing — retention change for auth logs you mentioned in the doc? what's the proposed retention windows?

Maria Chen: auth logs: default 180d for triage_view exports (masked), 3y for forensics_read exports (unmasked) with strict tenancy and billing tag required. archival to cold storage after 1y with CMK-wrapped objects.

Devon Ruiz: make sure the archive CMKs are in a different key ring and rotated independently. otherwise a single compromised path is risky.

Maria Chen: will add that. ok I'll open INC/TICKET templates and RFC thread. looking for volunteers to review the draft: @Aj Patel, @Devon Ruiz, @Samir.

Samir: I'll review the KMS + vault flow.

Aj Patel: I'll take RBAC rollout notes and the migration script.

Devon Ruiz: I'll handle audit schema and SIEM mapping docs.

security-bot: Reminder: schedule review meeting with sec-arch and infra on Monday 10am UTC.

Maria Chen: thanks everyone — I'll post the RFC link here when ready. :thumbsup:
